title: Team Bots: shared AI teammates that learn as they work
summary: Give a Grok Bot the files, apps, and expertise it needs, then share it so your whole team can work from the same context.
body: Give a Grok Bot the files, apps, and expertise it needs, then share it so your whole team can work from the same context.
summaryZh: xAI推出了名为Team Bots的新功能，允许用户向Grok Bot提供特定的文件、应用程序和专业领域知识，从而构建定制化的AI同事，并在整个团队中共享统一的上下文环境来协同工作。原始信息显示：Give a Grok Bot the files, apps, and expertise it needs, then share it so your whole team can work from the same context.。该消息由xAI News发布，主题为“Team Bots: AI coworkers that learn from your team”。其重要性主要体现在：xAI发布了面向团队协作的新功能Team Bots，允许用户定制并共享基于特定上下文的Grok助理。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
